messages:
Alice: Heads up — PR #3425 is CI-red on the typecheck/lint gate after the merge. Can someone quick-triage?

Alice: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3425 — small refactor touching shared typing helpers and engine bindings.

dev-bot: CI pipeline failed (3 jobs): pyright-check, mypy, rustfmt. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/inference/3425/build/failed

Ben: Quick glance at pyright log — looks like the repo-wide pyright config bumped strictness yesterday. Example: 
```
src/ui/hooks/usePrompt.ts:15:9 - error: Parameter 'opts' implicitly has an 'any' type. (reportImplicitAny)
```
This PR adds a call site that relies on implicit any.

Claire: mypy failure is separate: 
```
src/server/inference.py:122: error: Incompatible return value type (got "Optional[str]", expected "str")
```
Looks like a new upstream typing change made a return optional.

Priya: rustfmt complaining on engine change — two files need formatting. Pre-commit hooks also flagged ruff/black/isort. Probably the pre-commit hook versions changed on main.

Ryan: My hunch: main rolled a pyright/pre-commit bump (yesterday's revert PR). If you rebase onto main the CI might be consistent. Can someone try a targeted rerun first? If it stays red, we'll bisect.

Claire: I can bisect if rerun still fails after rebase. For now, can we just rerun the typecheck jobs only?

Ben: Doing targeted rerun: `/ci rerun pr=3425 jobs=pyright-check,mypy,rustfmt` — queued.

ci-bot: Rerun queued for jobs: pyright-check, mypy, rustfmt. Estimated start ~30s.

ci-bot: pyright-check succeeded ✅

Ben: Pyright green, mypy still failing with the same Optional->str error. So two independent issues.

Alice: I'll open a tiny follow-up commit to fix the mypy return (coerce with or "" guard) and add an explicit type annotation at the usePrompt call. Pushing now.

Ben: Re-running mypy+pre-commit after Alice's patch: `/ci rerun pr=3425 jobs=mypy,pre-commit`

dev-bot: pre-commit detected formatting changes (black/isort/ruff) — CI will run format step.

ci-bot: All requested jobs passed. ✅

Priya: Nice — all green. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :tada:

Ryan: FYI I'll follow up with a short PR to pin the pyright/pre-commit versions in our CI matrix so rollouts are less surprising.

Alice: Great plan. Thanks everyone for the quick triage.
